user.title: Connect to your ICT Protege panel
user.description: Uses the panel's Automation and Control service. Every door, area, input and output is found automatically.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Protege controller.
data_description.port: The IP Port set on the Automation and Control service (usually 21000).
data_description.pin: A user PIN with rights to doors, outputs and bypass. It does not need arm or disarm rights: arming always asks for the person's own code.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the host, the port, and that the Automation and Control service is enabled.
error.panel_error: The panel refused a request. Check that "Allow Status Requests When Not Logged In" is enabled on the service, and the logs for details.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This panel is already set up.
abort.wrong_panel: That address belongs to a different panel.

init.title: Event logging
init.description: Optional. Add a second Automation and Control service on the panel with its own port, and a view-only user with no control rights. The integration stays logged in on that service only to receive system events. Leave both fields empty to turn event logging off.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the events service port.
error.panel_error: The panel refused the event subscription.
error.events_incomplete: Enter both the port and the PIN, or leave both empty.
error.events_same_port: Use a separate service and port for events, not the control service.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the logs for details.

command_failed.message: The panel did not carry out the command: {error}

bypass_inputs_only.message: Bypass only applies to input bypass switches.

timed_outputs_only.message: Timed on only applies to outputs.

force_arm.name: Force arm
force_arm.description: Arm the area even if inputs are open.

turn_on_for.name: Turn on for
turn_on_for.description: Turn an output on for a set time, then off.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to keep the output on (up to about 18 hours).

bypass.name: Bypass input
bypass.description: Bypass an input. Temporary bypass ends when the area next disarms.

permanent.name: Permanent
permanent.description: Keep the bypass until it is removed.
